tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: List supported manufacturing processes, materials, and the fields an estimate accepts.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Get an instant cost estimate for a custom manufactured part. Returns unit price, total, lead time, and assumptions. Indicative and non-binding.

tools.name: refine_quote
tools.description: Refine a previous estimate (change quantity, material, tolerance, finish) by passing its quote_token.

tools.name: get_lead_time
tools.description: Estimated production lead time in days, by process and quantity.

tools.name: dfm_feedback
tools.description: Rule-based design-for-manufacturability feedback for a part specification.

tools.name: estimate_bom
tools.description:
Estimate costs for a multi-part bill of materials in one call.

    Each part: {process, quantity, material?, bounding_box_mm?, tolerance_mm?,
    finish?}. Returns per-line estimates, a BOM total, and the longest lead
    time. Indicative and non-binding. Max 50 lines.

tools.name: compare_processes
tools.description:
Compare cost and lead time for one part across manufacturing processes.

    Provide 2-8 process names and a quantity; returns per-process estimates
    sorted by total cost, plus a lowest-cost / shortest-lead-time note.
    Indicative and non-binding.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "discover_capabilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List supported manufacturing processes and what a quote requires." → after: "List supported manufacturing processes, materials, and the fields an estimate accepts."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
